caseNameFull: Edward N. Mittle v. State of South Carolina
attorneys: Mr. Charles A. Douglas, Mr. Hugh H. Obear and Mr. Cole L. Blease for plaintiff in error. Mr. Samuel M. Wolfe for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Section 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726; Jett Bros. Distilling Co. v. Carrollton, 252 U. S. 1, 5-6.
